title: Completed Blocksets
description: A simple mod that adds in some of vanilla's seemingly missing blocks. Includes 250 blocks!
body:
![Completed Blocksets Title Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/162d35bd1ed88165b13760c2b358270dea24c8af.png)
### **Support The Mod!** [![ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/img/githubbutton_sm.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/R7F720MP5G)
## **About** This mod adds blocks that are seemingly missing from vanilla's block sets. The additions are meant to be very vanilla-friendly, and for the most part re-use vanilla minecraft textures aside from a few exceptions. This mod currently includes **250 blocks in total** This mod is also available on [**CurseForge**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/completed-blocksets) ## **Features** ### **Blocks**
Full List - Amethyst - Stairs - Slab - Andesite Bricks - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Calcite - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Polished Calcite - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Calcite Bricks - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Concrete (All Color Variants) - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Copper Pressure Plate (All Weathering & Waxed Variants) - Dark Prismarine Brick Wall - Diorite Bricks - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Glazed Terracotta (All Color Variants) - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Gold - Door - Trapdoor - Bars - Chain - Granite Bricks - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - End Stone - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Polished End Stone - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Netherrack - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Packed Mud - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Polished Andesite - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Polished Cinnabar - Pressure Plate - Button - Polished Deepslate - Pressure Plate - Button - Polished Diorite - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Polished Granite - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Polished Sulfur - Pressure Plate - Button - Prismarine Brick Wall - Purpur Wall - Quartz - Wall - Smooth Quartz Wall - Quartz Brick - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Resin - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Polished Resin **(Obtained by smelting Resin Blocks)** - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Pressure Plate - Button - Sandstone - Smooth Sandstone Wall - Smooth Red Sandstone Wall - Cut Sandstone - Stairs - Wall - Cut Red Sandstone - Stairs - Wall - Smooth Stone Stairs - Smooth Basalt - Stairs - Slab - Wall - Stone Wall - Terracotta (All Color Variants) - Stairs - Slab - Wall
### **Other Changes** - **Replaced vanilla End Stone Bricks crafting recipe with Polished End Stone crafting recipe.** Four End Stone now crafts four Polished End Stone, and four Polished Endstone crafts four End Stone Bricks. - Added custom-made textures for block sets that were not present in any form in vanilla (Polished Calcite, Polished Endstone, Gold blockset, Polished Resin, Andesite Bricks, Diorite Bricks, Granite Bricks) - Added all blocks to vanilla's creative mode tabs, as well as a separate "Completed Blocksets" tab. ## **Check out my other mods!** [](https://modrinth.com/mod/ambient-creatures)
